evidence_text: Public fisheries reporting said serious red tide affected Musandam and South Sharqiyah coasts and advised avoiding seafood from the affected area.
A public report described active algae bloom conditions off the Omani coast, including desalination difficulties in the Sea of Oman and Arabian Sea.
A public operational report said algae bloom conditions were affecting desalination operations, with South Al Sharqiyah plant teams monitoring the event.
A public operational report said algae bloom conditions were affecting desalination operations, including a Sur-based plant experiencing higher treatment effort and cost.
